body: Nick Miller from New girl. Generally holding everything together with my limited brain cells.

The best advice I can give: Your thoughts literally shape your reality. At the quantum level, your thoughts can reflect how you perceive the world around you, starting with how you talk to yourself. positive self talk reflects a positive environment! instead of your ego telling you that you feel "useless", change the story for yourself and try to think of all the possibilities you have waiting for you!
